status_meanings.pending: A prerequisite or implementation is not available yet.
status_meanings.available: The stage ran and produced usable output.
status_meanings.cached: A prior usable output was reused because its cache key is unchanged.
status_meanings.model_review_pending: The output exists and is queued for automated model evaluation.
status_meanings.model_uncertain: Automated model evaluation completed but could not make a sufficiently confident decision.
status_meanings.verified: The output passed the configured quality gate.
status_meanings.rejected: The input was evaluated and excluded with evidence.
status_meanings.failed: Execution was attempted but did not produce a valid output.

routing_classes.card_collection: A source containing multiple possible card regions; the observation profile determines the actual geometry.
routing_classes.individual_card: A source image representing one card rather than a multi-card collection.
routing_classes.non_card: A readable source that is not quiz-card content, such as a board image.
routing_classes.unknown: A source for which the available evidence is insufficient for a safe routing decision.

classification_policy.routing_rule: Exactly one routing_class may control downstream geometry. Unknown produces no accepted regions and blocks dependent stages for that source, while preserving all observations and region candidates.
classification_policy.open_set_rule: The classifier must prefer unknown over a low-confidence or out-of-taxonomy routing result. New visual roles, subtypes, anomalies, and layout patterns are recorded in observation_profile without changing routing until a versioned contract change adds a routing class.

classification_output.routing_class: Exactly one routing_classes value; this is the only field allowed to select downstream geometry.

observation_profile.content_roles: One or more descriptive roles, including quiz_card_front, card_back, game_board, text_page, photo, decorative, mixed_content, or unknown.
observation_profile.visual_state: front, back, mixed, unreadable, or unknown.

layout_pattern.family: grid, single, composite_regions, irregular_regions, none, or unknown.
layout_pattern.row_coefficient: Normalized usable-height share per row, or null when no row model is credible.
layout_pattern.column_coefficient: Normalized usable-width share per column, or null when no column model is credible.
layout_pattern.row_gap_coefficient: Normalized vertical gap estimate, or null.
layout_pattern.column_gap_coefficient: Normalized horizontal gap estimate, or null.
layout_pattern.confidence: Confidence in the layout pattern and coefficients.

observation_profile.region_candidates: Zero or more normalized region proposals with role, coordinates, transform, producer, and confidence.
observation_profile.anomalies: Structured observations such as game_board, card_back, mixed_orientation, border_noise, or non_uniform_spacing.
observation_profile.feature_summary: Deterministic and model-supported visual facts retained for later analysis.

classification_layers.purpose: Extract reproducible image and file features without a model call.
Use the labeled contact sheet to compare sources and identify collection-level visual patterns.
Fuse source features and collection evaluation into the first routing decision.
Diagnose only sources that remain unknown after first-level fusion and provide evidence for later reprocessing.
classification_layers.selection_rule: Run only when the first-level routing_class is unknown or its decision state is model_review_pending.

classification_layers.purpose: Re-run classification with diagnostic hints as additional evidence without changing the original decision record.

unknown_handling.initial_route: unknown emits zero accepted regions and blocks only dependent geometry and extraction for that source, but retains all feature, role, anomaly, and layout observations
unknown_handling.diagnostic_route: unknown_source_evaluation runs automatically and produces diagnostic observations and hints, never an authoritative routing class
unknown_handling.replay_route: classification_replay may accept a routing_class or retain unknown
unknown_handling.persistence: Every layer is stored as an immutable artifact with input hashes, producer/version, scores, response hashes, and replay key
unknown_handling.no_forced_class: A source remains unknown when deterministic fusion cannot meet the configured confidence and consistency gates

required_evidence: deterministic rule IDs and configuration hash
model deployment, prompt hash, and response hash when model evaluation runs
classification layer, producer, layer input fingerprint, and prior decision reference
